name: opencode-workbench
description: One-command reproducibility for your AI-agent workstation. Eleven tools let an agent inspect, plan, apply, verify, update, and remove an idempotent, consent-gated clone of the full OpenCode stack — the OpenCode CLI, 35 MCP servers, agent skills, plugins, and Docker infrastructure — onto any Linux machine, over SSH or locally, with zero secrets ever written. bootstrap_host does it end-to-end, including a kernel-up platform scan and a recorded OpenCode version pin.
